title: Dxcufgb's lively tokens
description: Cinematic animated effects around tokens: 63 designs (Druid, Magic Smoke, Chains, Clockwork, Swirling Flame, Glyphs, God Rays, Leaves & Petals, Particles, Wormholes, Storm, Frost, Tide, Arcane Ward, Bard's Song, Charm, Necrotic, Orbiting Stones, Knives, and a particle effect for every D&D 5e class: Rage Embers, Encore, Radiance, Wild Bloom, Steel Sparks, Ki Flow, Holy Aura, Hunter's Trail, Shadow Step, Wild Surge, Eldritch Pact, Spellweave, Arc Forge, and one for every species: Celestial Plumes, Dragon's Breath, Stoneheart, Fey Grace, Gnomish Fizz, Giant's Stride, Lucky Stars, Heroic Inspiration, Adrenaline Rush, Hellish Legacy, Twin Heritage, Relentless, and one for every background: Votive Glow, Maker's Mark, Sleight of Hand, Alley Smoke, Showstopper, Harvest Breeze, Lantern Watch, Waypoint, Still Mind, Coin Shower, Regal Bearing, Ink & Lore, Sea Spray, Quillwork, Veteran's March, Wanderlust, Hearthfire, Starlit Camp, Street Scraps) with several styles each. Stack several into one ring, use your own images, add glow, pulse, rainbow and spin, and save your combinations. Live preview window, Token Controls button and character sheet entry.
